top_story: A sharp but brief escalation along the Israel-Lebanon front on 19 June killed at least 47 people in Lebanon and four Israeli soldiers before Israel and Hezbollah moved to restore a ceasefire set to begin Friday afternoon. The immediate picture is one of fragile containment rather than resolution, with Lebanese civilians bearing the heaviest costs and any border violence retaining the power to upend regional diplomacy.
